Class NumberEncoder

public class NumberEncoder

Utility class for encoding and decoding multiple decimal values into a single Long value for efficient aggregation.

Methods

public List<Decimal> decode(Integer recordCount)

Decodes the previously encoded value back to the original decimal numbers.

Parameters:
    recordCount – The total number of records that were encoded and summed

Returns:
    List of three decimal values representing the decoded numbers

public static List<Decimal> decode(
  Long encodedSum,
  Integer recordCount
)

Decodes a sum of encoded records back to the original three decimal totals.

Parameters:
    encodedSum – The sum of encoded Long values
    recordCount – The total number of records that were encoded and summed

Returns:
    List of three decimal values representing the decoded sums

Exceptions:
    IllegalArgumentException – if recordCount is less than 1

public List<Decimal> decodeAbs()

Decodes the previously encoded value back to the original decimal numbers.

Returns:
    List of three decimal values representing the decoded numbers

public static List<Decimal> decodeAbs(Long encodedSum)

Decodes a sum of absolute-encoded records back to the original three decimal totals. No recordCount needed since absolute-value encoding doesn't use offsets.

Parameters:
    encodedSum – The sum of encoded Long values

Returns:
    List of three decimal values representing the decoded sums

public Long encode()

Encodes the first three numbers in the list into a single Long value. If fewer than three numbers are present, zeros are added to fill the remaining positions.

Returns:
    Encoded Long value representing the three decimal numbers

public static Long encode(
  Decimal num1,
  Decimal num2,
  Decimal num3
)

Encodes three decimal values into a single Long value for efficient aggregation. Each decimal is converted to an integer by multiplying by 100 to preserve two decimal places.

Parameters:
    num1 – First decimal value (must be between -99.99 and 99.99)
    num2 – Second decimal value (must be between -99.99 and 99.99)
    num3 – Third decimal value (must be between -99.99 and 99.99)

Returns:
    Encoded Long value representing the three decimal numbers

Exceptions:
    IllegalArgumentException – if any value exceeds the allowed range

public Long encodeAbs()

Encodes the first three numbers in the list into a single Long value. If fewer than three numbers are present, zeros are added to fill the remaining positions.

Returns:
    Encoded Long value representing the three decimal numbers

public static Long encodeAbs(
  Decimal num1,
  Decimal num2,
  Decimal num3
)

Encodes three decimal values using their absolute values into a single Long value for efficient aggregation. No offset is needed since absolute values are positive-only, eliminating the need for recordCount during decoding.

Parameters:
    num1 – First decimal value (absolute value must be between 0 and 99.99)
    num2 – Second decimal value (absolute value must be between 0 and 99.99)
    num3 – Third decimal value (absolute value must be between 0 and 99.99)

Returns:
    Encoded Long value representing the three absolute decimal values

Exceptions:
    IllegalArgumentException – if any absolute value exceeds 99.99

public NumberEncoder withNumber(Decimal num)

Adds a decimal number to the encoder's list.

Parameters:
    num – The decimal number to add (null values are treated as 0)

Returns:
    This NumberEncoder instance for method chaining
